description: Land Acquisition - Divest an allotment in Makumbura, Maharagama D/S Division, Colombo District and Revoke the order published in Gaz. Ex. No. 1659/10, Welivitiya-Divithura D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains specific orders for divesting and revoking land allotments, including detailed descriptions of land parcels, their boundaries, and extents. The content focuses exclusively on land-related administrative procedures without involving government personnel changes, structural changes, or any other specialized categories.
